notes: Bendall notes that Siddhinṛsiṃha (King Siddhinarasiṃha Malla of Patan, r. 1620–1661) is mentioned at fol. 61a l. 7. Govinda-candra mentioned at 1b is the dramatic character of the play and is excluded. The manuscript is heavily damaged at the end and no explicit colophon date is transcribed.
